baseline_observations: index-START.html contains an empty <script> block and does not register navigator.geolocation.watchPosition.
Hardware and permission dependencies (GPS sensor, device compass heading) are unstubbed in default headless test environments.
There was no documented walkthrough specifying the entrypoint, local setup, and expected rotation and speed changes.
decision: Implement the geolocation watcher logic with null-safe fallbacks in index-START.html, add a documented and executable walkthrough in README.md, and create tests/course/r57-t017.mjs to stub native geolocation permissions and coordinates in Chromium, asserting correct speed text and compass arrow transformation.
